citation.description: record_failure() resolves step/model_class from ContextVar, derives counters from failure_usage(), and calls record() with op, model, provider, step, model_class, and outcome=OUTCOME_FAILED. Called from runner.py lines 520-522 inside the except block before interpret_failure.

criteria.criterion: A failed LLM call writes a usage row carrying the same identifying fields a successful one does (op, step, model_class, model, provider) plus whatever token counters are known, so a JSONL spend total includes failed calls

citation.description: OUTCOME_OK='ok' and OUTCOME_FAILED='failed' are defined; record() writes 'outcome' key unconditionally on every row (line 298); record_failure passes outcome=OUTCOME_FAILED (line 369). Test test_the_failure_row_is_explicitly_distinguishable_from_a_successful_call asserts both rows have distinct explicit outcome values.

criteria.criterion: The row is distinguishable from a successful call — the shape is the implementer's call, but it must be explicit, not inferred from a missing field

citation.description: 10 tests, all using FunctionModel that raises, driving PydanticAIRunner.run() with REBAR_USAGE_LOG pointed at a temp file, then reading the file. No assertions on usage_log.py source or failure_usage() in isolation.

criteria.criterion: Asserted by a test in which the model RAISES and the log is then read — not by reading usage_log.py, and not by asserting on failure_usage() in isolation

citation.description: record()'s 'if not path or not usage: return' guard is untouched. summarize() is unchanged and folds all rows including failure rows. Tests test_a_failed_call_writes_nothing_when_the_log_is_not_configured and test_summarize_still_folds_a_log_containing_a_failure_row cover both guarantees.

criteria.criterion: The existing no-op-when-unset and summarize()-still-folds guarantees still hold

citation.description: record_failure()'s entire body is wrapped in try/except Exception that logs and swallows (line 371-372). Tests test_recording_the_failure_does_not_convert_or_swallow_the_provider_error and test_an_unwritable_log_still_lets_the_provider_error_through pin this discipline.

criteria.criterion: Telemetry must never break the call path: the record must not convert a provider failure into a different exception, nor swallow the original

citation.description: record_failure() is called only in the except block (lines 520-522); record() is called only on the success path (line 592). The two paths are mutually exclusive. Tests test_a_failing_run_writes_one_row_not_one_per_attempt and test_a_retried_call_is_not_counted_twice_as_delivered_work verify no double-counting.

criteria.criterion: No double-counting: a call that fails and is then RETRIED must not be recorded such that the same spend appears twice as delivered work
